entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I... I need to return an item I bought. It's the VeloBand Pulse.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I'm on the right page, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, there's nothing wrong with it. It's still in the box. It's just... we had a family emergency right after it was delivered, and I can't use it now. It's been a very difficult couple of weeks.

I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay. Let me pull up your order. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 16 days ago. I do need to let you know that for this specific device, our return policy is 10 days.

Ten days? Oh, no. I had no idea. My husband had to have an unexpected surgery, and I've basically been living at the hospital. The package just sat by the door. I've been a loyal customer for years... and with the medical bills, I really, really needed that money back.

I understand completely. Please, don't worry. Hearing about a medical emergency like that changes things. We have exceptions for exactly these kinds of situations. I am so sorry you had to go through that, and I hope your husband is recovering well.
He's getting there, thank you. So... you can help?

Absolutely. I am more than happy to make a one-time exception given the circumstances. It's the least we can do. I am authorizing a full refund for you. I will email you a prepaid return shipping label right now. Just send the unopened band back to us, and once it's received, the refund will be processed to your original form of payment.
Oh, thank you! Charlie, you have no idea what a relief this is. After everything with the hospital and the emergency surgery, this is a huge weight off my shoulders. Thank you so much.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. The email with the label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again for your kindness.
It was my pleasure. I wish your husband a very speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
